title: HB 303 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 2, relative to evidence of identification for voting.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec.1, amends TCA 2-7-112(c)(2)
(quote) (2) A valid identification card that contains a photograph of the voter, and that was issued by this state, or by the United States where authorized by law to issue personal identification;
(section) Sec.2, adds 2-7-112(c)(8)
(quote) (8) A valid identification card that contains a photograph of the voter and that was issued by an accredited postsecondary institution of education in this state.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Sec.3: secretary of state study of student ID cards for voting, done within existing resources; first report Jan 31, 2024, second report on use of (c)(8) Jan 31, 2025; subsection repealed Feb 1, 2025.
(other) Sec.4: effective on becoming law.
(other) version: Draft 2651141: carries slot a (student photo ID as (c)(8)); study with reports Jan 31, 2024 and Jan 31, 2025.
(other) version: Drafts 2657274, 2775406, 2881306: word-for-word the same operative text as 2651141; only the printed sponsor/companion header lines change (SB 285 companion added; later headers show different House sponsors).
(other) note: Companion SB 285 (same text). The four saved Draft files are one text re-printed after sponsor changes. Skeleton shows no votes. Last actions in the data are sponsor changes (2024-01-10); no committee vote recorded and no enactment.
